# Wake Forest erupts for 61 points in second half, routs UMass Lowell 109-75

- AP
- Nov 16, 2025 WINSTON-SALEM, N.C. (AP) Juke Harris and Tre’Von Spillers each scored 21 points and Wake Forest Demon Deacons rode a 61-point second half to a 109-75 rout of UMass Lowell River Hawks on Sunday. The Demon Deacons led by 10 points at halftime and were up by 13 a few minutes into the second half before an 18-0 run put the game well in hand. Nate Calmese scored 10 points in the outburst and Wake Forest led 76-45 with 12 1/2 minutes ... Wake Forest last scored 100 points in a 101-78 victory over Elon in November 2023. UMass Lowell visits Bradley on Wednesday. sources.title: College roundup: UML men’s basketball team falls at Wake Forest
highlights:
Mass Lowell men’s basketball team figured to have a difficult time Sunday afternoon. Facing ACC member Wake Forest, a program which has developed the likes of NBA legends Tim Duncan and Chris Paul, the River Hawks put up a solid fight in the first half, trailing by only 10. But Wake Forest turned it on after intermission to post a 109-75 win over the River Hawks during a non-league encounter before 6,825 fans in Winston-Salem, N.C. JJ Massaquoi enjoyed an afternoon to remember for UML, as he netted a game-high 26 points on 11-for-15 shooting from the floor. A powerful 6-foot-6, 235-pound guard, Massaquoi hails from Prince George’s County, Md. Adding 10 points each for the River Hawks were Khalil Farmer and Austin Green. UML (1-4) has lost four straight since opening the season by drilling Rivier at home. Impressively, the River Hawks scored 38 points in the paint against Wake Forest (3-1). The hosts, however, scored 25 points off turnovers to pull away. The River Hawks trailed 48-38 at halftime.
